notes.title: Clazer Full Release
notes.notes:
[b]Shotgun Training with Virtual Reality [/b]
	
Would you like to play a virtual reality clay shooting simulation with your own shotgun? Now you can with CLAZER’s [url=https://clazer.club/virtual-reality-gun-controller/]Virtual Reality Gun Controller[/url]!

We are excited to share with you this update to Clazer and the new Virtual Reality Gun Controller that lets you play with any type of Shotgun, Redgun, or Airsoft using a Vive Tracker. 

Patch Notes:
	• Updated project to support latest version of SteamVR & Oculus Rift libraries 

	• Added support for the Valve Index

	• Added support for SteamVR bindings 

	• Improved realistic lighting and coloring on the Clays

	• Updated shotgun selection with 28, 30, and 32 inch barrel length versions. 

	• Added support for the VR Gun Controller
		○ (requires hardware)
		○ Hold trigger to open calibration menu

	• New DRONE shooting mode 

	• Implemented slow motion feature in all modes

	• Added field highlight for currently active trap machine(s) in Five Stand

	• Improved overall simulation performance

	• Misc. bug fixes

notes.title: Competition Time Update
notes.notes:
We are releasing some things players have asked for. Enjoy shooting!

- New Global Leaderboards in Trap and Five Stand

 - We have majorly upgraded two handed shotgun support. We now have more realistic control of the shotgun with both arms. 

- Two handed control is now required for competition mode

- Full locomotion using the offhand touch-pad on Vive and left thumb-stick on Oculus Rift. 

- Added Windows 10 voice support for the PULL command. Just say pull. 

On Windows 10 : 
Open Speech Recognition by clicking the Start button, clicking Control Panel, clicking Ease of Access, and then clicking Speech Recognition.
Click “Train your computer to better understand you.”
Follow the instructions on the screen.

- We have mapped the P key to the PULL command. If you have your own voice software, you can map any word you like to the P key. 

- We smashed a few other minor pesky bugs

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26868358/7438784b76b392928ae1692ec051d98c87833302.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Clazer 2.0 - 'Hands and Guns' Update
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce our first big update! 

Clazer 2.0 brings a bunch of new content and features including new guns, hand rendering, shotgun reloading, two-handed shotgun mechanics, laser pointers, and even more realism.  

We have also blasted some of those pesky bugs! 

Our new update fully supports the HTC Vive, Oculus Rift with Touch, and Oculus Rift with Xbox Controller.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26868358/f665163d7e8fdc1401895d1c8795e9a322340714.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26868358/388a9fec2a0de09a8524c87df505e14bcc9021d0.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26868358/6fe7dd01a34d298a9c0551560174c79ba7ae0b7f.jpg[/img]

Patch Notes :

New Shotguns
•	New 20 gauge Side by Side
•	New 28 gauge Over Under
•	Shotgun table for swapping between weapons 
•	Each shotgun has an optional laser pointer
    o	    Swipe down on Vive touch-pad
    o	    Press B on Xbox controller when using Oculus

Hand Rendering 
•	Your hands are now tracked and rendered when playing with Vive or 
         Oculus motion controllers. 
•	Hand animations for holding each shotgun, holding the barrel, pulling trigger, and reloading.
•	Full support for right or left handed shooters 

Shotgun Mechanics (Reloading / Recoil / Doubled-Handed)
•	All shotguns have new reloading animations and mechanics. 
    o	    Use both hands to reload when using motion controllers. 
•	Added shotgun recoil to each shotgun
•	Added optional double-handed shotgun holding mechanics 

New Tutorial 
•	Added a new tutorial in the menu that teaches the basic mechanics of the simulation.
•	Added a new tutorial in Skeet that explains the UI 

Misc.
•	There are new muzzle and projectile effects for each shotgun
•	Improved shotgun rendering / lighting
•	Added voice over audio throughout each simulation mode
•	Added a pull command for more instant, on demand clay pulls
•	Changed shotgun fire SFX to 3D sound

Bugs
•	Removed high peaking winds from ambient audio 
•	Clay machines are now properly shown on the UI before calling pull in Five Stand
•	Fixed rare issues occurring in competition mode 
•	Misc. minor bug fixes

notes.title: Left Handed Shooting
notes.notes:
Clazer has been updated with left handed shooting support when using the Oculus Touch controllers. 

Simply pull the trigger on the controller you want to use (Left, Right, Gamepad). 

Enjoy Shooting!

notes.title: Oculus Support is now available through Steam.
notes.notes:
We have released an update that includes support for Oculus Rift, Oculus Touch, and PC gamepad / Xbox controllers. 

Achieving a perfect game in Skeet competition will now grant you an extra low tower shot at station 8. 

Some adjustments have been made to improve the Skeet competition leaderboard. 

Minor bug fixes.
